title: FAITHFUL BI-DIRECTIONAL MODEL STEERING VIA DISTRIBUTION MATCHING AND DISTRIBUTED INTERCHANGE INTERVENTIONS
findings: When suppressing refusal behaviors in safety-aligned models, the proposed steering method (CDAS) and a related baseline (DAS) generally preserved the models' performance on the MMLU 'world_religions' sub-task, while other methods like RePS and DIM often degraded performance.
